valid.name: options are added to the version price
single group surcharge is added to the line, not a replacement
valid.why: Standard equipment has no price and is not passed in. The surcharge 120000 is ADDED: line = 1500000 + 120000 = 1620000 (not 120000). VAT = 324000. Gross = 1944000. Extra keys (is_surcharge, group_name) are ignored.

valid.name: VAT on the total, not per line (differs by one cent)
valid.why: Lines 3 and 3, net 6. Per line: 3 * 0.2 = 0.6 -> 1 each, sum 2. On the total: 6 * 0.2 = 1.2 -> 1. The total is authoritative: VAT 1, gross 7.

valid.name: VAT rounds half up (exactly half)
valid.why: 5% of 10 = 0.5 -> rounds up to 1. Gross = 11. (At 20% no net gives an exact half: net * 0.2 never ends in .5.)

valid.name: VAT rounds half up at rate 5000
VAT just under half rounds down
empty offer
valid.why: No items: all zeros, no lines.

valid.name: 200 options (the limit) and a large quantity
20 items (the limit)
valid.why: Twenty lines of 100 each: net = 20 * 100 = 2000. VAT = 400. Gross = 2400.

invalid.name: one item above the total limit
two items that together pass the total limit
items is an object, not a list
